findings.title: Conflicting alias fields are silently selected instead of rejected
findings.evidence: With a valid complete shape, adding evidence.canonical_object_sha256=f*64 while retaining object_sha256 and recomputing the signature binding digest returned OK_SHAPE_ONLY; adding a conflicting witness.signature_material_ref returned OK_SHAPE_ONLY; adding a conflicting authority.receipt returned OK_SHAPE_ONLY. The first alias is selected and the replacement/conflict is ignored.
findings.contract: Frozen interface contracts require structural mismatch to fail_closed; witness contract requires exact digest/binding and strict object boundaries.
findings.required_fix: For every alias pair, reject simultaneous non-identical values with a deterministic conflict code; compare evidence digest aliases before binding/signature checks; do not silently prefer ack over receipt or signature_material over signature_material_ref.
